source: Eight historical Kargo hire CVs, supplied hires/ folder; performance ratings from case problem statement. Not derived from job descriptions.

criteria.name: Field-level workflow understanding
criteria.description: Worked directly with freight, customs, carrier or similarly operations-heavy users; describes specific handoffs, exceptions and documentation constraints, rather than generic industry familiarity.
criteria.evaluation_guidance: 0: evidence unavailable. 1-3: generic claim or supporting participation only. 4-6: concrete personal action but unclear autonomy or outcome. 7-8: clear action, scope and relevant result. 9-10: repeated, independent, adopted improvements with specific outcomes. PM: clear personal contribution within one workflow; collaboration is acceptable. Quote exact sanitized CV text; do not infer missing facts.
criteria.rationale: Rohan built tools after managing shipment documentation; Sunita handled customs documentation; Aditya worked terminal operations; Meghna resolved customs holds; Lavanya managed carriers. Vikram and Rahul show SaaS expertise without the same field exposure.

criteria.name: Self-started improvements that stuck
criteria.description: Identified an unassigned operational gap, built a practical solution and shows that real users or teams adopted it.
criteria.evaluation_guidance: 0: evidence unavailable. 1-3: generic claim or supporting participation only. 4-6: concrete personal action but unclear autonomy or outcome. 7-8: clear action, scope and relevant result. 9-10: repeated, independent, adopted improvements with specific outcomes. PM: clear personal contribution within one workflow; collaboration is acceptable. Quote exact sanitized CV text; do not infer missing facts.
criteria.rationale: Rohan initiated shipment tracking and verification; Sunita redesigned intake without notice; Meghna created standard onboarding; Lavanya initiated visibility and carrier reviews. These are concrete self-started changes, not just assigned delivery.

criteria.name: Independent ownership through closure
criteria.description: Owns a complete workflow across stakeholders, makes calls without a senior decision layer and follows implementation through adoption or resolution.
criteria.evaluation_guidance: 0: evidence unavailable. 1-3: generic claim or supporting participation only. 4-6: concrete personal action but unclear autonomy or outcome. 7-8: clear action, scope and relevant result. 9-10: repeated, independent, adopted improvements with specific outcomes. PM: clear personal contribution within one workflow; collaboration is acceptable. Quote exact sanitized CV text; do not infer missing facts.
criteria.rationale: Sunita scoped migration, coordinated vendor, trained staff and monitored go-live; Aditya owned the entire sales cycle; Meghna owned six-week resolution and customer communication; Lavanya was sole PM and closed outage actions. Rahul also has this strength, so it alone does not predict success.

criteria.name: Learning from uncomfortable decisions
criteria.description: Gives a concrete example of changing course, diagnosing failure or owning a post-mortem, with the resulting corrective action.
criteria.evaluation_guidance: 0: evidence unavailable. 1-3: generic claim or supporting participation only. 4-6: concrete personal action but unclear autonomy or outcome. 7-8: clear action, scope and relevant result. 9-10: repeated, independent, adopted improvements with specific outcomes. PM: clear personal contribution within one workflow; collaboration is acceptable. Quote exact sanitized CV text; do not infer missing facts.
criteria.rationale: Aditya documented the lost-account procurement error; Lavanya killed two low-adoption features and owned outage retrospectives. This signal is present in fewer successful profiles, so it receives a lower weight and is treated as a hypothesis.

criteria.name: Operational results beyond output
criteria.description: Connects work to documented adoption, avoided disruption, reduced support or improved workflow reliability, with scope and a specific result.
criteria.evaluation_guidance: 0: evidence unavailable. 1-3: generic claim or supporting participation only. 4-6: concrete personal action but unclear autonomy or outcome. 7-8: clear action, scope and relevant result. 9-10: repeated, independent, adopted improvements with specific outcomes. PM: clear personal contribution within one workflow; collaboration is acceptable. Quote exact sanitized CV text; do not infer missing facts.
criteria.rationale: Rohan reduced lag and incidents; Sunita preserved continuity and passed inspections; Meghna reduced churn and avoided shipment delay; Lavanya reduced support and delivery exceptions. Vikram and Preetham also show metrics, so metrics alone are insufficient.
